definitions.explanation: The northeastern region of Honshu, comprising the six prefectures of Aomori, Iwate, Miyagi, Akita, Yamagata, and Fukushima. Also used for the northeast compass direction in general.

examples.japanese: {東北|とうほく}は{雪|ゆき}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: It snows a lot in the Tohoku region.

examples.japanese: {東北|とうほく}{新幹線|しんかんせん}で{仙台|せんだい}まで{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to Sendai on the Tohoku Shinkansen.

examples.japanese: {東北|とうほく}{地方|ちほう}には{温泉|おんせん}や{自然|しぜん}が{豊|ゆた}かな{場所|ばしょ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: The Tohoku region has many places rich in hot springs and nature.

notes:
Compound of {東|ひがし} (east) + {北|きた} (north), pronounced とうほく. Refers primarily to the Tohoku region of northeastern Honshu, but can also indicate the northeast compass direction in technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {東北|とうほく}{地方|ちほう}: Tohoku region
- {東北|とうほく}{新幹線|しんかんせん}: Tohoku Shinkansen
- {東北|とうほく}{弁|べん}: Tohoku dialect
- {東北|とうほく}{出身|しゅっしん}: from Tohoku

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
The region was severely affected by the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake and tsunami. Known for its harsh winters, distinctive dialects, and traditional foods such as {牛|ぎゅう}タン (Sendai beef tongue) and きりたんぽ.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {関東|かんとう}: Kanto region (around Tokyo)
- {関西|かんさい}: Kansai region (around Osaka)
- {北海道|ほっかいどう}: Hokkaido (separate northern island)
